The '''President of Solara''' is the national executive office of [[Solara]].

== Origin ==

The office is first source-attested in 1538, after the [[Solaran War of Unification]]. The victorious coalition selected [[John "Lee" Greener]] as the first president because of his wartime actions.

The source connects the presidency to the founding of Solara as a parliamentary democracy, but it does not define the original election law, term length, cabinet system, or relationship between the president and the [[Solaran Parliament]].

== Constitutional Role ==

Later source text describes the president as head of state and places the military under civilian government authority. For the 1994-back draft, the safest reading is that the presidency became the visible national executive within a parliamentary democratic order, while parliament remained the main representative institution.

== Open Canon ==

Solara needs a later government pass to define vice-presidential succession, cabinet appointment, emergency powers, and whether the office changed after the [[Avant Great War]] or the [[Solara-Khalindar War]].
